brief: Prioritise outstanding work according to its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat, completing work in categories one to three before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows (SOP-016). Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023). Record every de-rating applied, including the reason, value, and period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified (MG-021).
